description: This file defines the interface for the data pipeline module in a Wi-Fi management system, including function declarations for initializing, queuing reports, and retrieving data related to network statistics and device info.

methods.name: dpp_init
methods.description: Initializes internal structures for the data pipeline.

methods.name: dpp_put_bs_client
methods.description: Queues band steering client report data.

methods.name: dpp_put_client_auth_fails
methods.description: Queues client authentication failure report data.

methods.name: dpp_get_report
methods.description: Retrieves protobuf packed buffer for MQTT transmission (standard pack).

methods.name: dpp_get_report2
methods.description: Retrieves protobuf packed buffer for MQTT transmission (fast pack).

methods.name: dpp_get_queue_elements
methods.description: Returns the number of queued statistics reports.
